method.title: 法语CTA慢速识别恢复但正常速度仍不确定
method.trigger: 该源法语片尾CTA的完整性在模型结果间存在分歧。
method.action: 保留慢速和正常速度结果及未选用试验，补充实际编码音频的正常速度独立听审；未确认前维持对应版本阻断。
method.failure_signature: 两次完整TTS输出漏CTA；慢速V6识别出预期短语，正常速度V6及V7仍不明确。
limitations: 一源法语、同会话模型证据；无正常速度人工听审。
不能据此断言ASR正确或实际发音错误。
Quoted observations do not prove causality or validate the proposed action; controller review required.
method.next_counterexample_test: 独立听审当前实际编码片尾及完整上下文，核对CTA是否完整可懂。

record.hypothesis: For this exact source, compare the complete outgoing UI boundary and every input placeholder before accepting text coverage. Retain observed lower-resolution donor, repair texture and transition defects as limitations. Check actual encoded head and tail audio independently after sample-index mixing; successful TTS or mixing does not establish spoken coverage. Two full French TTS outputs omitted the CTA. Slowed V6 audio recovered the expected phrase, while normal-speed V6 and the lower-tempo V7 trial remained ambiguous. This is evidence of unresolved verification, not proof that ASR is correct or that pronunciation is wrong; V7 remains an unselected trial and external publication stays blocked.
limitations: Exact source and locale only; same-agent samples and ASR, no normal-speed human listening or independent acceptance.
No new company preference, quality standard or cross-source method is activated.
Ordinary visual defects remain; publication does not mean internal quality passed.
record.promotion: Candidate only; separately review the independent evidence before any activation.
record.evidence_boundary: Technical observation and hashes; raw private case is not needed to read this hypothesis. Activation requires independently packaged reviewed evidence.

activation: Developer review required; no validated rules changed
